For the rest of combat, gain Omnivamp and Attack Range, and replace attacks with a slam that deals magic damage to the target and nearby enemies.

ability.name: Pounce Party|Dance of Life
ability.description: In Cougar Form, Pounce Party pounces on enemies, dealing magic damage that increases with each pounce. In Human Form, Dance of Life heals, then hurls a javelin at the target for magic damage and scatters flowers around them; after a brief delay, the flowers deal magic damage to enemies nearby.

ability.name: It's the Time to Disco!
ability.description: Passive: Gain Mana Regen. Slowly roll a Disco Ball, dealing magic damage to all enemies it passes through. Active: For the rest of combat, move faster and increase the Disco Ball’s size and damage.

ability.name: Execute Gon' Give it to Ya
ability.description: Passive: When an enemy drops below the health threshold, instantly cast on them, then dash back to the current target. Active: Deal physical damage to the target and to other enemies in an X shape. Execute enemies below the health threshold.

ability.name: Rhythm Blaster | Metal Pony Club
ability.description: While unmounted, Rhythm Blaster grants a shield and summons 3 speakers for a duration. Each second, they blast a wave that deals magic damage to enemies hit. While mounted, Metal Pony Club slams into a crowd, dealing magic damage to the center enemy and damage split among enemies within 2 hexes.

ability.name: Crowd Surfing
ability.description: Throws rocks at the target, each dealing magic damage. Every few casts, quickly repositions and surfs in a line, dealing magic damage based on enemies’ max Health and briefly knocking up enemies hit.

ability.name: Going Viral
ability.description: Passive: Attacks apply Viral, dealing magic damage over time. Infected enemies become zombies on death, seeking unaffected enemies and exploding to damage adjacent enemies and apply Viral. Active: Launch a mushroom that applies Viral to enemies within 3 hexes and deals magic damage, reduced for each hex from the center.

ability.name: Wildcard Cortado
ability.description: Passive: At combat start, draw a card for each champion in the shop. If the shop has refreshed this round, gain loot based on the cards drawn: 1 or 2 of a kind grants gold, 3 of a kind grants a random champion, 4 of a kind grants an item component, and 5 of a kind grants a mystery box. Active: The next 5 attacks gain Attack Speed and are replaced with cards that deal magic damage to the target and 2 nearby enemies.

ability.name: Drop the Beatdown
ability.description: Summon giant hologram fists, gain a shield for a duration, and shield nearby allies. Slam the target repeatedly, dealing physical damage to them and damage to other enemies within 2 hexes. EDM Upgrade: Slam one additional time and heal for a portion of the damage dealt by this ability.

ability.name: The Opera Phantom
ability.description: Passive: Gain Omnivamp. Debuffed enemies are Captivated. Active: Deal magic damage to the nearest enemies and Captivate them for a duration. Every few casts, drop a chandelier that deals magic damage to all enemies, reduced for each hex they are from the epicenter. Debuffs include Burn, Wound, Shred, Sunder, Mana Reave, Weaken, Slow, and Vulnerable.

ability.name: Lasers After Midnight
ability.description: Quickly dashes around the arena, firing lasers in rapid succession at the current target. Each laser deals physical damage to enemies hit and ignores a portion of their Armor.

ability.name: Assemble the Ensemble
ability.description: Summon an 8-member orchestra and a Riff Herald, knocking up all enemies. Deal physical and magic damage split among all enemies. Each minion attacks multiple times, dealing physical damage with each attack.

ability.name: Fly like a Peacock
ability.description: Dash to a nearby group of enemies, then fling feathers split among enemies within 1 hex, dealing magic damage. Rakan hits enemies within 2 hexes and briefly knocks them up.

ability.name: Upswing
ability.description: Passive: Gain Beats per attack and cast periodically. Active: Gain a shield and deal physical damage to all enemies within 2 hexes, then strike the current target multiple times, dealing physical damage plus additional damage per Beat. After unleashing a set number of Beats, gain an emblem for a trait you don’t have active; the number of Beats required increases.

ability.name: feat. Sona
ability.description: Passive: Cannot attack. Every few seconds, gains Mana, deals magic damage to nearby enemies, and grants allies a Shield for a duration. Active: Sends a sonic wave across the battlefield, dealing magic damage split among all enemies and Stunning them for a duration. Allies gain a Shield split among them for a duration.
